# Subway Seat for Slack

Slack only lets themes colour the sidebar and a few highlights; the message pane follows Slack's own light or dark mode, so pick dark for Walnut and Tunnel and light for Enamel.

[Slack](https://slack.com) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/slack/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.txt`](subway-seat.txt) | Slack → Preferences → Appearance → Custom theme |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.txt`](subway-seat-tunnel.txt) | Slack → Preferences → Appearance → Custom theme |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.txt`](subway-seat-enamel.txt) | Slack → Preferences → Appearance → Custom theme |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Slack → Preferences → Appearance → Custom theme:

```text
Paste the Subway Seat string from subway-seat.txt into any message and click
“Switch sidebar theme”, or enter the four colours under Custom theme.
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Slack → Preferences → Appearance → Custom theme:

```text
Paste the Subway Seat Tunnel string from subway-seat-tunnel.txt into any message and click
“Switch sidebar theme”, or enter the four colours under Custom theme.
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Slack → Preferences → Appearance → Custom theme:

```text
Paste the Subway Seat Enamel string from subway-seat-enamel.txt into any message and click
“Switch sidebar theme”, or enter the four colours under Custom theme.
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
